regularization: 0.1 dropout in unfrozen blocks; frozen batchnorm statistics; optional 4-frame feature mask
schedule: one-epoch linear warmup then cosine decay to 10% peak
selection: Lowest mean of per-dataset validation WER, with no per-dataset WER or CER regression versus baseline; require 0.5 percentage point mean WER gain
test_note: LRS2 official test only, previously examined. LRS3 trainval validation is held out of local training, not original pretraining; no official LRS3 test included.
